Preferred Details





Please note - The download is in the form of a text file with Pipe Delimiters (the '|' symbol).

If the file will be viewed in MS Excel, please follow the instructions below.
If the file is to be viewed as a text file, it is recommended that Notepad++ is used. Download Notepad++ by clicking HERE.

Once the download is saved these steps can be followed to import the file to Excel:
- Open Microsoft Excel.
- Select 'Data' from the horizontal Excel menu (ribbon) at the top of the page.



- Select 'From Text' then browse to the downloaded text file. Double-click the file.



- In the Text Import Wizard ensure that 'Delimited' is selected. Check the box "My data has headers'. Click 'Next'.



- Ensure that the 'Other' Delimiter ONLY is selected and type in the pipe symbol '|' (SHIFT + \) in the box. Click 'Next'.



- Select the 'General' data format and click 'Finish'.



- In the Import Data window select the worksheet and cell from where the download should start. Click 'OK'. Please make sure to name and date the file before saving it.
